name: When should I call a professional for a moldy smell in my vents?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a moldy smell in my vents?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional if the moldy smell is persistent, covers a large area, or if you suspect mold is hidden within your HVAC system or walls. If you or family members are experiencing mold-related health symptoms, professional assessment is also recommended. DIY solutions are often insufficient for extensive mold, which requires specialized equipment and expertise to safely and effectively remove and prevent recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if the moldy smell is persistent, widespread, hidden, or if you or others are experiencing health symptoms.
